description: This file defines a TimeSpan class with methods for time duration calculations and formatting, and related time period functionalities. It appears to be part of a date/time utility library used in the project.

classes.name: TimeSpan
classes.description: A class representing a span of time with methods to manipulate and format durations.

classes.name: TimePeriod
classes.description: A class representing a period between two dates, including components like years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds.

methods.name: getTotalMilliseconds
methods.description: Returns the total number of milliseconds represented by the TimeSpan instance.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this TimeSpan with another time object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this TimeSpan is equal to another time object.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds another TimeSpan or duration to this TimeSpan.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts another TimeSpan from this TimeSpan.

methods.name: addDays
methods.description: Returns a new TimeSpan with days added.

methods.name: addHours
methods.description: Returns a new TimeSpan with hours added.

methods.name: addMinutes
methods.description: Returns a new TimeSpan with minutes added.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Returns a new TimeSpan with seconds added.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Returns a new TimeSpan with milliseconds added.

methods.name: getDesignator
methods.description: Returns AM or PM designator based on the time.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the TimeSpan, formatted according to the provided format string.
